contentRequirements.content:
- Alt text: Actual educator or issuing organization; Minimum-data issuer-specific verification; Privacy, correction and withdrawal controls. No production composition is authorized in 2026.10. All future layout choices remain deferred until governance and destination tests are approved.
- Editable source: retain separately addressable geometry and live-label regions; later micrographic copy, table cells and data remain editable and translatable. The SVG and PNG are private visual references, not production assets.
- Reference image output: Codex must provide `assets/reference/bd-v-075-ref.svg` and a matching `assets/reference/bd-v-075-ref.png` when the production gate is clear; never JPG.
- Use in colour, grayscale, print, and on a phone: inspect the stated reading order at 960 × 540 and at phone width; distinguish relationships by position, shape or line style as well as colour; retain a white background, generous copy space and live 12pt-or-larger learner text in production. Check that arrows and object silhouettes remain distinguishable without colour.

style.layoutReference: Selected pattern: Process flow. Selected layout: teaching-page; full-width figure region.
style.typography: Live IBM Plex Sans, 400 body and 500 labels; use 600 only for a single controlled emphasis. Learner-facing print copy at least 12pt. Short literal labels, left aligned and translation-ready; do not bake copy into reference artwork.
style.shapeAndLineRules: Flat shapes, restrained monoline outlines, butt caps and miter joins; straight or right-angle connectors, open chevron heads and filled node dots. Use exactly 13° only for meaningful structural cuts or hatch, never tilt people or labels. No decorative frames.
style.geometry: 13° structural slant only where instructional; upright people, icons and live labels. Reference topology: deferred
style.emphasis: One controlled orange instructional focal point; no orange full-field background or ranking

prohibitions: No financial, legal, tax, accounting, compliance or investment advice; no provider recommendation, guaranteed safety/returns/adoption or universal local/legal conclusion.
No real secrets, seed words, private keys, identities, balances, payable addresses, invoices or payment QR data. Fictional payment screens require editable SAMPLE — DO NOT PAY in later production.
Keep user, educator, wallet, service, node, miner and protocol roles distinct; Bitcoin is not stored inside a wallet, miners do not make the rules, and no single controller approves Bitcoin.
No restricted-pilot app links, QR assets, calls to download or assessment/certification evidence.

No crypto hype, gold Bitcoin coins, generic blockchain imagery, corporate-cartoon proportions, gradients, glossy or 3D effects, shadows, decorative clutter, unapproved icons or redrawn official MFB marks.

Reference only: white background; render no visible text, letters, numerals, punctuation, placeholder text or encoded payment data. Preserve all live copy and warnings in this brief and JSON for later editable implementation.
